reddit.title: Improved Music Transitions in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the music experience in Provincia! The day, night, title, and combat music beds now feature smooth transitions instead of abrupt cuts. This long equal-power crossfade ensures a seamless listening experience, even during AI transitions. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops

steam.title: Provincia Update: Enhanced Music Transitions
steam.body: We're excited to announce an update that improves the music transitions in Provincia! The day, night, title, and combat music beds now feature smooth crossfades, eliminating abrupt cuts. This enhancement ensures a more immersive experience as you build your colony. Learn more about these changes and other updates in our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
